'''Working memory''' refers to the short-term memory in which a small amount of [[information]] are stored for a short period of time while being processed.

== Human working memory ==

The human working memory is essential to the everyday functioning of human being (e.g., to process sensory information and make decisions) and understanding and learning new concepts.<ref>{{#cite:Q3005}}</ref>

See [[Random access memory (RAM)]].
